playStyles.visual: Decision-tree play: tap a picture/choice, a generated transition clip carries you A to B, you arrive. Level 1 of the game is the decision layer.
playStyles.fps: First-person shooter play: independent engine, pointer lock, WASD. You relearn the game on purpose.
playStyles.exploration: Independent third-person walking exploration: keyboard, touch controls and tap-to-walk, scripted NPC conversations, enterable shops and fictional game-credit inventory. No shooter mechanics.
